name: proxmox
description: Lets Sidekick securely discover and operate Proxmox VE infrastructure through administrator-configured named profiles, pinned-CA TLS, normalized state, deterministic maintenance preflight, same-cluster guest migration, governed provisioning/lifecycle, optional Ansible, and critically guarded retirement of proven disposable resources.

knowledge.title: Proxmox pack: operating model and tools
Proxmox pack: API tokens and least-privilege permissions
Proxmox pack: task semantics and operational safety
Proxmox pack: provisioning, provenance and controlled automation
Proxmox pack: read-only health, capacity and upgrade readiness
Proxmox pack: guest inventory and backup coverage
Proxmox pack: storage health and backup history
Proxmox pack: normalized guest configuration audit

allow_destroy.description: Explicit administrator enablement for guarded retirement of positively proven Sidekick-managed disposable guests. Disabled by default; does not permit unmanaged or protected resources.

protected_resources.description: Guests that mutating/destructive operations must never touch, matched by vmid, tag, or name glob. A match is a hard deny in addition to Proxmox's own protection flag.

ansible.description: Optional Ansible integration. Absent or unconfigured means Ansible is simply unavailable. Point playbook_dir at an administrator-controlled directory of allowlisted playbooks on the Sidekick host.

allowed_hosts.description: Optional allowlist of destination host addresses ansible_run may target.

ssh_key_dir.description: Optional directory that ssh_key_file values must resolve inside.

profiles.description: Administrator-configured Proxmox environments, keyed by profile name. Endpoints and credential references live here; secret VALUES never do. Store the API token with the secret tool and reference it as token_ref: "secret:<name>".

tls_servername.description: Optional DNS name used for TLS SNI and certificate validation when endpoint is an IP address.
